note: A record OF the Phase 5 technical baseline, frozen before Phase 6 begins. Every digest below was RECOMPUTED from the bytes on the builder and compared against what the build recorded; none was copied forward from a previous document. Evidence in qualification/phase4/ and qualification/phase5/ is never edited by Phase 6.
measuredBy: qualification/phase6/baseline/freeze-baseline.sh, run as root on the Fedora reference builder

repository.headIsNotAnArtifact: No artifact was built from 0d5381c6. HEAD is a tree; the artifacts below are identified by digest and provenance.

subjectArtifact.role: The artifact Phase 6 binds its evidence to. Decided at Phase 6 opening: it is the only artifact carrying installation, encryption, login, voice, Trust and persistence evidence, and the only one with an installation medium.
subjectArtifact.name: Alpha Release Candidate
subjectArtifact.locationNote: Moved intact from build/out/beta in Phase 5 because build-image.sh refuses a non-empty output directory. Moved, not rebuilt, not renamed.

counterpartArtifact.role: N+1 for the update and rollback questions. Not a release candidate, carries no journey evidence, and has no installation medium.
counterpartArtifact.name: Phase 5 build
counterpartArtifact.installationMediumNote: None exists. This artifact cannot be installed on a physical machine or a fresh VM without first building a live ISO from it. That is one reason it is the counterpart and not the subject.

buildInputs.baseImageDrift: The upstream tag no longer resolves to the digest either artifact was built from. fedora-bootc:44 is rebuilt frequently and old digests are not retained upstream. Only the local retained copy makes the subject artifact base input reconstructible, and it is present in the store.
buildInputs.buildEnvironment: Fedora Linux 44 under WSL2, kernel 6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2, 22 cores, podman 5.8.4, image-builder 76.0.0 / osbuild 185

referenceSuite.rootCause: Host PSI memory pressure reaching the visual slice through an unpinned signal. Fixed by pinning the five host-derived signals the capability ladder can degrade on, guarded structurally by test_slice_host_invariance.py.
referenceSuite.conditions: Fedora reference target, as user bunny, from an ext4 clone. /mnt/c produces nine false failures and root produces one more.
referenceSuite.boundToArtifactNote: The reference suite measures the tree, not the artifact. It is recorded here because it is a required gate, not because it certifies either image.

security.note: The same image and the same grype binary report 8 Critical against an SBOM and 1 against a binary-reading route, because the newer database carries qualifiers.go_imports and the binaries do not contain the named functions. The conservative figure is recorded because a Critical disposition must be argued against the conservative number.

updateQualification.productBehaviour: Inert by design. /etc/bunny-os/update.json ships enabled:false with an updates.invalid.bunny-os.example URL; /usr/share/bunny-os/update-keys/ contains only revoked-keys.json and no trusted key.
updateQualification.stagedUpdate: PASS - the shipped bootc staged N+1 onto a copy of N; the disk went from one deployment to two
updateQualification.manifestScenarios: cannot run - no update trust root exists in the image

rollbackQualification.product: PASS - bootc rollback then reboot brings up e906a48793d7 from e501218f2fe0, agreed by per-deployment os-release, the kernel command line and bootc status. All five user-state markers survive.
rollbackQualification.harness: NOT_RUN - vm-rollback-test.sh deployment-rollback had been reporting PASS for three runs that all booted the default deployment. Repaired to identify the booted deployment from the kernel ostree= argument; it now exits 5 NOT_RUN on the same disk.

performance.openQuestion: A 1.27 percentage-point unexplained regression in gnome-shell idle CPU between 7edd3fd (0.80%) and the RC (2.07%).
performance.refuted: The poller hypothesis. /proc reads measured at 0.006% of one core - 200x too small to account for it.
performance.remaining: Rendering and redraw cost under the VM software renderer.
performance.note: Every performance number this project holds was measured under llvmpipe. None of it transfers to a real GPU.
